description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandawala, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad Map No. 521001 (24/0744)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal descriptions of multiple properties in the Colombo District. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
